scan_rule: Inspect every GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE operation. A route is apparently paid if it declares x-price, a 402 response, or payment-required language. Among apparently unpaid operations, retain those whose contract mentions URL fetch, A2A, Agent Card, credential, passport, trust or verification.

relevant_apparently_unpaid_operations.summary: Get a templated workflow prompt for a single skill pack

interpretation: The sole text-relevant unpaid route returns a templated workflow prompt; it cannot fetch Agent Guild, verify a Guild artifact, run preflight, use a trust result or produce an attributable AG action. Agent402's first-party contract states that every /api/* and /v1/* operation is pay-per-call or proof-of-work except discovery resources, and the useful outbound URL routes declare payment. The prior proof-of-work card validation remains interoperability evidence only.
